name: Labor rights compliance
desc_html:
National compliance with labor rights — freedom of association and collective bargaining — measured against ILO textual sources and national legislation. This is SDG indicator 8.8.2.
A higher score means more violations, so lower is better: the scale runs from 0 for full compliance upward.
